title: From Where to How: Continuous 4D Interaction Forecasting from Egocentric Video
abstract: arXiv:2609.08636v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Egocentric 4D interaction forecasting aims to anticipate both where future interactions will occur in 3D and how the human body will move to realize them, providing an important capability for assistive robotics and human-computer interaction. Existing methods struggle to translate semantic understanding into precise continuous 3D localization and to balance motion diversity with structural consistency in pose forecasting. More fundamentally, these tasks are often modeled separately, leaving the continuous geometric and temporal correspondence between interaction locations and body motion insufficiently captured. To address these challenges, we introduce Coherent4D, a large-scale egocentric dataset for continuous 4D interaction forecasting, comprising approximately 233K samples across three domains. translated_title: 从“何处”到“如何”：基于第一人称视角视频的连续4D交互预测
translated_abstract: 第一人称视角4D交互预测旨在预测未来交互将在三维空间中的何处发生，以及人体将如何运动以实现这些交互，这是辅助机器人和人机交互领域的一项重要能力。现有方法难以将语义理解转化为精确的连续三维定位，也难以在姿态预测中平衡运动的多样性与结构一致性。更根本的是，这些任务通常被分开建模，导致交互位置与身体运动之间的连续几何与时间对应关系未能被充分捕捉。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了Coherent4D，一个用于连续4D交互预测的大规模第一人称数据集，包含跨三个领域的约23.3万个样本。每个样本将未来三维交互位置序列与相应的全身姿态配对，二者在时间上对齐并表达于共享坐标系中（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了Coherent4D——一个包含约23.3万样本、覆盖三个领域的大规模第一人称数据集，通过将未来三维交互位置与全身姿态在时间和空间上对齐建模，实现了“预测交互发生在何处”与“预测身体如何运动”的统一连续4D交互预测。
en_tdlr: Coherent4D, a large-scale egocentric dataset with ~233K samples across three domains, unifies future 3D interaction localization with temporally-aligned full-body pose forecasting to enable coherent continuous 4D interaction prediction.
